exposure: modified natural frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles
cohort: The study included 839 patients undergoing single blastocyst frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles between 2014 and 2020 at a university-affiliated fertility practice.
finding: There were no differences in most perinatal outcomes, including ischaemic placental disease, IUGR, preterm delivery, or SGA, between programmed and modified natural FET cycles, but programmed cycles showed an increased risk of caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Patients in the programmed cohort had an increased risk of caesarean delivery compared to those in modified natural FET cycles.
